item.title: Self-Organization in 2025
item.description: Over the years I tried different approaches to organize my life and keep track of stuff. There are a Lot of great methodologies, but IT took me some time until I figured out what works best for me. My current workflow is a pretty simple and straight forward hybrid approach between digital and analog techniques.
